estimand: For each original 3000-episode trajectory and budget B, prefix_auc_goal(B) is the mean GoalReached over episodes 0 through B-1 and trailing_training_goal_rate(B) is the mean over episodes B-100 through B-1. Each paired contrast is computed within seed before aggregation.
limitations: The budgets were selected after the source campaigns and this analysis is not confirmatory.
These are prefixes of the original 3000-episode learner, whose epsilon and stereotype-prior schedules were configured for 3000 episodes; they are not reruns configured with shorter total budgets.

Only the training-trajectory GoalReached column is available at each prefix. The trailing 100-episode training goal rate is descriptive and is not a greedy-policy benchmark; no intermediate Q-table checkpoints exist, so prefix greedy-policy benchmark goal rate cannot be estimated.

Paired arms are required to have identical deterministic scenario sequences. Because the 11-scenario Lab 2 cycle does not divide the selected budgets or the 3000-episode horizon exactly, each accepted prefix is near-balanced: every scenario is present and per-scenario counts differ by at most one.
The historical 0.0111 auc_goal anchor is shown only as context and is not a decision threshold registered for this analysis.
No p-values, q-values, confirmatory verdicts, or changes to the Phase-1/Phase-1b registered conclusions are produced.
